notes.title: Visualis Electromagnetism Update !
notes.content:
We're happy to release our latest update of Visualis Electromagnetism ! 🧲
Here's a quick review of what's new since the first release :

✨ Interactive Learning !  Dive deeper in Physics with interactive PDFs on main demo scenes ! 
🧲 Fields : Custom f(t) support for charged plates, enhanced field rendering on large scales, dynamic charge and plate appearances.
🏆 Achievements : New 'charges loop' demo scene and achievement to show the magnetic field generated by moving charges !
🚀 Enhanced Performance : Small optimizations and more accurate simulation steps for a smoother experience.
🖥️ Compatibility & Graphics : We've fixed specific driver errors, screen capture issues, we have enhanced OpenGL anti-aliasing, and resolved possible glitches in graphs displays.
📂 Compatibility & Windows : Fixed issues on scenes access rights and read-only folders.
🖱 GUI / Interactivity : Improved mouse interactions, small GUI fixes, direct links to demo scenes !

Thank you very much for your support, your feedback is really helpful for future Visualis Electromagnetism development ! 😉
